title: Canonical derived composition is localized normalized ordinary composition
statement: Let h:Z→W and k:W→V be scheme maps with arbitrary commutative ring sheaves RV,RW,RZ and specified inverse-image coefficient isomorphisms ck,ch,c. Suppose c equals their canonical composite coefficient identification [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Let d:R_h⋙R_k≅R_(h≫k) be an ordinary module direct-image compositor whose map on each section is restriction along Over.pullbackComp.hom. Use the actual unit-normalized module adjunctions. The canonical derived pullback composition, transported from the composite coefficient identification to c, equals the localization of the inverse leftAdjointCompIso conjugate of d followed by the exact derived-functor composition isomorphism. The canonical ambient comparison is the construction of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]; localization uses the natural exact-derived factorization isomorphisms. No finiteness hypothesis on the coefficient sheaves is imposed.

proof.text: The actual ordinary module adjunction satisfies the stated unit-section normalization: transpose the identity, use its normalized Hom-equivalence characterization, and evaluate the unit on sections. Two normalized adjunctions coincide by equality of their units.

Extract the normalized witnesses carried by the ambient canonical comparison. The preceding unit uniqueness fixes the three adjunctions, and the section formula fixes d. Injectivity of conjugation fixes the ordinary inverse-image compositor to the inverse leftAdjointCompIso of the actual adjunctions and d.

Reuse the proved private comparison-witness and exact-localization helpers of ProEtaleDerivedPullbackCoherence through a private import-all. The degree formula identifies the complex comparison with the mapped ordinary comparison; localization factorization and composition coherence identify the specified derived compositor. Transport along the coefficient equality finishes.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleCanonicalDerivedPullback_normalization
    {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V)
    (RV : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RW : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RZ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (ck : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage k CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RV ≅ RW)
    (ch : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RW ≅ RZ)
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage (h ≫ k) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RV ≅ RZ)
    (hc : proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k RV RW RZ ck ch = c)
    (d : proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage h RW RZ ch ⋙
      proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage k RV RW ck ≅
        proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage (h ≫ k) RV RZ c)
    (hd : ∀ (N : proEtaleRingModules Z RZ) (U : V.ProEt)
      (m : ((proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage h RW RZ ch ⋙
        proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage k RV RW ck).obj N).val.obj (Opposite.op U)),
      (d.hom.app N).val.app (Opposite.op U) m =
        N.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp
          (P := @WeaklyEtale) (Q := ⊤) h k).hom.app U).op m) :
    eqToIso (congrArg (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback (h ≫ k) RV RZ) hc.symm) ≪≫
        proEtaleCanonicalDerivedPullbackComparison h k RV RW RZ ck ch =
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction k RV RW ck)
          (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction h RW RZ ch)
          (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction (h ≫ k) RV RZ c) d).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso (proEtaleRingModulePullback k RV RW ck)
          (proEtaleRingModulePullback h RW RZ ch)
